comment: v0.2.6 source-package pin: a multi-module package must survive build -> install -> consume. The pak now carries the entry plus its full relative-import closure (verbatim .cp3 sources, exact folder structure), so the consumer compiles against real units instead of a signatures stub whose relative imports dangled (CP3601) and whose hidden types failed to resolve (CP3302). Before the fix this case fails at step 3 with CP3601 on every relative import of the installed stub.
